# Model decoders

Copied from `three@0.186.1`, the application's pinned release:

- `draco/*`: glTF Draco decoder and WebAssembly wrapper, Google Draco, Apache-2.0.
- `basis/*`: Basis Universal transcoder used by KTX2Loader, Binomial, Apache-2.0.

The application serves these files from its own origin; no third-party decoder CDN is required. Preserve the matching version when upgrading Three.js. Copyright notices in the JavaScript wrappers are retained. Full licenses are included in this directory, along with the Three.js and fflate MIT licenses.
